title: kbmon lists an ask as needing the operator after its gate was answered and its item landed, since backlog.py answer never closes the ask
goal: An ask that names a backlog gate stops showing under kbmon's needs-you line and coord panel once that gate is answered (by backlog.py answer, operator or provisional) or its item is done or deleted: today mon_coord closes an ask only on a coord answer event (_tools/mon_coord.py CLOSED) and backlog.py answer posts none, so five asks of 2026-10-27 about gates of ST-zkhku3sg, ST-3j3wlgg4, BG-okrkeohe and ST-6zg57xiu, all answered and their items done, still read as needs you, each telling the reader to run answer --recommended on a gate already answered otherwise. The ask kbmon still shows names the gate it waits on.
